description: This file provides functions to fetch project cost details and cost history sum from a backend API, using a client to make HTTP GET requests.

methods.name: getProjectCost(projectId)
methods.description: Fetches the aggregated cost for a specific project by calling the backend API endpoint '/api/projects/:projectId/cost'. Returns an object with projectId, cost, and currency.

methods.name: getProjectCostHistorySum(projectId)
methods.description: Fetches the total cost of a project based on session tracking cost history deltas by calling the endpoint '/api/projects/:projectId/cost-history-sum'. Returns an object with projectId and cost.
